content.title: Selling Digital Products from Africa: The Complete Infrastructure Guide

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters

This infrastructure solution is built on a combination of Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, and NOWPayments for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification. By using this stack, creators can accept international payments in various cryptocurrencies, bypassing traditional payment platforms like Stripe that often restrict transactions from certain countries. This approach not only expands their customer base but also provides a more secure and transparent payment process, with no risk of account restrictions or platform downtime.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture works by leveraging Cloudflare Pages to host the creator's digital products, while Cloudflare Workers handle the backend logic for payment processing and order management. NOWPayments integrates with Cloudflare Workers to verify on-chain crypto payments, eliminating the need for traditional payment gateways. This setup enables creators to receive payments in a variety of cryptocurrencies, such as USDT on Tron, which settles in under 60 seconds for a fee under $0.10.
Who This Is Built For and Why

Cloudflare Pages and GitHub Pages both provide free static site hosting that works identically regardless of where the store operator is located. A store deployed on Cloudflare Pages by a creator in Harare is served from Cloudflare's global edge network — the same infrastructure that serves enterprises in New York. Neither platform imposes geographic restrictions on who can deploy a store or who can access it. Combined with NOWPayments for payment processing and Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, this creates a complete commerce infrastructure with zero hosting costs and no geographic restrictions at any layer of the stack.
Creators in restricted countries can now sell digital products globally without relying on traditional payment platforms.
The Components That Make It Work Together

Creators in Ethiopia, Cameroon, Tanzania, Venezuela, Zimbabwe, and the Philippines face a compounded challenge: not only are conventional payment platforms unavailable, but local banking infrastructure may add additional friction to receiving international transfers through alternative channels. Crypto payments remove this layer entirely. A seller in Addis Ababa and a seller in Amsterdam receive USDT transactions through the same NOWPayments infrastructure, at the same speed, with the same 0.5% fee. The blockchain has no knowledge of which country a wallet is located in. The webhook fires to both backends identically. Geographic neutrality is not a feature — it is the fundamental property of how blockchains work.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy this solution today, creators can start by purchasing the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which includes all 6 blueprints and 7 templates needed to build, deploy, and scale a sovereign digital commerce stack. They can then follow the provided documentation and guides to integrate Cloudflare Pages, Cloudflare Workers, and NOWPayments, and start accepting international crypto payments on their website.
How can creators in Africa sell digital products to international buyers?

The most practical path for creators in restricted countries starts with NOWPayments configured to receive USDT on Tron as the primary payment coin. USDT is a stable coin pegged to the US dollar — your revenue does not fluctuate with crypto market movements. Tron network fees are under $0.10, and settlement takes under 60 seconds. Once USDT arrives in your wallet, you convert to local currency through P2P exchanges — Binance P2P is available in most countries and supports naira, cedis, Kenyan shillings, and Pakistani rupees. The conversion takes 20 to 30 minutes on average and costs 2 to 5 percent.
USDT on Tron settles in under 60 seconds for a fee under $0.10, providing fast and affordable payment processing.

For creators in Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Pakistan, and Bangladesh, this solution provides a lifeline to the global market. By leveraging this infrastructure, they can sell their digital products to international buyers, expand their customer base, and increase revenue. To learn more about the tools and resources needed to deploy this solution, visit our product page at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) is a comprehensive package that includes everything needed to build, deploy, and scale a sovereign digital commerce stack, and is available for instant download.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy this solution, follow these concrete steps: purchase the Complete Builder Kit ($197) and familiarize yourself with the included documentation and guides; set up Cloudflare Pages to host your digital products; integrate Cloudflare Workers for backend logic and payment processing; set up NOWPayments for on-chain crypto payment verification; configure Binance P2P for peer-to-peer currency exchange; test your setup thoroughly to ensure seamless payment processing and order management.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I set up Cloudflare Pages to host my digital products?

To set up Cloudflare Pages, create a new site and upload your digital products to the Cloudflare Pages dashboard. You can then customize your site and configure payment processing using Cloudflare Workers and NOWPayments.
What cryptocurrencies are supported by NOWPayments?
NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, including popular options like USDT on Tron, which settles in under 60 seconds for a fee under $0.10.
Can I use this solution with Binance P2P for peer-to-peer currency exchange?
Yes, you can use Binance P2P for peer-to-peer currency exchange with this solution, enabling seamless currency exchange and payment processing.
How do I integrate Cloudflare Workers with NOWPayments for payment processing?
To integrate Cloudflare Workers with NOWPayments, follow the provided documentation and guides to configure payment processing and order management using Cloudflare Workers and NOWPayments.
What if I encounter issues with payment processing or order management?
If you encounter issues with payment processing or order management, refer to the provided documentation and guides, or contact our support team for assistance.
